remarks: Step into sophisticated living with this exceptional 4-level townhouse offering 2,095 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space. Located in one of Norwalk's most convenient and desirable areas, this residence combines upscale finishes, spacious living, and unbeatable proximity to shopping, transit, and major corporate centers. The main level welcomes you with gleaming hardwood floors, a cozy gas fireplace, and an open-concept living and dining area that's perfect for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a bright breakfast nook-ideal for everyday living or hosting. Upstairs, the primary suite is a luxurious retreat with vaulted ceilings, two walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bathroom with radiant heated floors. A second generously sized bedroom with an en-suite bath and heated floors offers comfort and privacy for family or guests. The fully finished lower level includes a flexible space with a full bath-perfect for a family room, guest suite, or home office. A finished top floor adds even more versatility for a playroom, workout space, or abundant storage. Step outside to your private patio, great for morning coffee or evening gatherings. Enjoy the ease of an attached garage plus a reserved parking spot. Situated within walking distance to the brand-new Merritt 7 Metro-North station, this home is ideal for commuters and professionals. Take advantage of on-site walking paths, a dedicated dog walk and a common area.
